hero_background.description: Modern corporate hallway with glass doors, architectural and clean, suitable for a dark blue gradient overlay.

about_us.description: Professional team in a business meeting, ideal for the About Us section.

dashboard_empty_state.description: Office desk with financial charts to use as a placeholder or empty state in the client portal.

services_bg.description: Professionals reviewing financial graphs, used as background or side image for the services grid.

general: Use Greek language for all content as provided.
Never use Inter or Roboto for headings; strict adherence to Playfair Display for headings and Manrope for body.
Do not use heavy drop shadows. Keep interfaces flat, architectural, and bordered (1px solid slate-200).
Use high contrast. Text on #1E3A8A must be white. Text on white/gray must be dark slate.
marketing_site: Hero section should feature the hero background image with a dark blue overlay (e.g. bg-[#1E3A8A]/80) to ensure white text is highly readable.
The logo 'DM' must appear in header and footer as dark blue serif letters with a horizontal underline.
Services grid should feel premium; use generous padding, subtle hover lifts, and refined icons.
dashboard: Dashboard must follow a calm, trust-first layout. Top-left widget should be the North Star metric.
Use Recharts for financial KPIs (revenue, expenses, profit trend, VAT).
Chart colors must map strictly to the blue/gray corporate palette.
Widgets must use border-slate-200 and white backgrounds on a #F5F5F5 page background.
testing: All interactive elements must include 'data-testid' attributes (e.g., 'contact-submit-button', 'login-button').

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement a full-stack Next.js or React app. For the frontend, strictly use Tailwind CSS with the defined colors and typography. Integrate Shadcn UI but customize the rounded corners to be sharper (rounded-none or rounded-sm) to match the corporate premium feel. Implement Recharts for the client dashboard with the provided chart_palette. Follow all data-testid rules.
